_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN archipelago.json, README and releases. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same platform do.
_platform_source: README: mods install by dragging them onto the Zelda64Recomp window, a PC program
description: Majora's Mask as a multiworld, played through the PC recompilation.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game -- no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until somebody has played it through London. Built is not tested.
_requires_source: Zelda64Recomp builds from the player's own Majora's Mask ROM
_mod_kind_source: Zelda64Recomp is a static recompilation of the Nintendo 64 game into a native PC executable. The same game, rebuilt -- so fan_port, not fan_game.

client.name: Majora's Mask Recompiled Client
client._kind_source: the mod talks to Archipelago itself from inside the recompiled game
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: the repository's own releases page; latest v0.9.5a carries mm_recomp.apworld

_install_kind_source: README: the apworld into custom_worlds, and MMRecompRando.zip dragged onto the Zelda64Recomp window, which extracts and installs it itself. London does not drive that window, so the mod step is the player's.
setup: Install the latest Visual C++ Redistributable -- the README links it.
Download mm_recomp.apworld and MMRecompRando.zip from the release.
Put mm_recomp.apworld in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Drag MMRecompRando.zip onto the Zelda64Recomp window BEFORE pressing Start Game.
Start the game and connect it to the room.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.

credits._note: Majora's Mask is Nintendo's and is never distributed here; the player supplies their own ROM for the recompilation to build from. The randomizer is RecompRando's. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.
